mostWorthwhile.text: Following the returning fluid into cooler seawater was most worthwhile: it connected mixing and cooling to mineral precipitation.

leastWorthwhile.text: Heating the water and then combining it with the same hot rock again felt a little repetitive, even though the second action revealed rock–water reactions.

surprise.text: I was interested that buoyancy and pressure differences can drive water back through a different part of the fractured system.

arbitrary.text: Using open fractures to turn precipitating minerals into a deposit felt somewhat abstract, although the result explained accumulation around an outlet.

continue.text: I would continue: the circulation loop made the physical processes clear, and I would be curious to see what happens next, though the mostly single-option sequence offered few meaningful choices.
